title: Introduction to CUDA Operators
text:
CUDA operators are fundamental computational kernels that perform specific operations on GPU. 
Common operators include GEMM (General Matrix Multiply), Softmax, Reduction, ReLU, and Convolution. 
These operators form the building blocks of deep learning frameworks and high-performance computing applications. 

Each operator requires careful optimization to achieve peak performance on GPU hardware. 
Understanding their implementation details helps developers write efficient CUDA code. 
The key challenge is balancing computation and memory access patterns. 

GPU architecture differs fundamentally from CPU architecture. 
GPUs have thousands of smaller cores optimized for parallel throughput. 
CPUs have fewer powerful cores optimized for sequential latency. 
This architectural difference requires different programming strategies.
textTranslate:
CUDA 算子是执行特定 GPU 操作的基础计算内核。 
常见的算子包括 GEMM（通用矩阵乘法）、Softmax、Reduction、ReLU 和 Convolution。 
这些算子构成了深度学习框架和高性能计算应用的基础构建块。 

每个算子都需要仔细优化才能在 GPU 硬件上达到峰值性能。 
理解它们的实现细节有助于开发者编写高效的 CUDA 代码。 
关键挑战是平衡计算和内存访问模式。 

GPU 架构与 CPU 架构有根本性差异。 
GPU 有数千个较小的核心，针对并行吞吐量进行了优化。 
CPU 有较少但强大的核心，针对顺序延迟进行了优化。 
这种架构差异需要不同的编程策略。

title: GEMM: General Matrix Multiply
text:
GEMM (General Matrix Multiply) is one of the most important operations in linear algebra and deep learning. 
It computes C = A × B, where A is M×K, B is K×N, and C is M×N. 
The naive implementation has poor performance due to repeated global memory accesses. 

Each element C[i][j] requires K multiplications and K-1 additions. 
For large matrices, this results in O(M×N×K) operations. 
The naive kernel launches one thread per output element. 
Each thread reads A's row and B's column from global memory, causing O(K) memory accesses per element. 

Optimized GEMM uses tiled matrix multiplication with shared memory. 
The key idea is to divide matrices into tiles and load them into fast shared memory. 
Each thread block computes one tile of the output matrix C. 
Data reuse through shared memory reduces global memory traffic significantly.
textTranslate:
GEMM（通用矩阵乘法）是线性代数和深度学习中最重要的操作之一。 
它计算 C = A × B，其中 A 是 M×K，B 是 K×N，C 是 M×N。 
由于重复的全局内存访问，朴素实现的性能很差。 

每个元素 C[i][j] 需要 K 次乘法和 K-1 次加法。 
对于大矩阵，这导致 O(M×N×K) 次操作。 
朴素内核为每个输出元素启动一个线程。 
每个线程从全局内存读取 A 的行和 B 的列，导致每个元素 O(K) 次内存访问。 

优化的 GEMM 使用共享内存的分块矩阵乘法。 
关键思想是将矩阵分成块并加载到快速的共享内存中。 
每个线程块计算输出矩阵 C 的一个块。 
通过共享内存实现数据重用，显著减少了全局内存流量。

title: Tiled Matrix Multiplication: Thread Mapping
titleTranslate: 分块矩阵乘法：线程映射
text:
The tiled matrix multiplication kernel follows a specific workflow. 
First, each thread determines its global coordinates (m, k) in the output matrix C. 
The mapping uses block and thread indices: m = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y, k = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x. 

Each thread block is a 2D grid of threads, typically 16×16 or 32×32 threads. 
The block computes a TILE_SIZE × TILE_SIZE submatrix of C. 
Threads within a block use threadIdx.y and threadIdx.x for local coordinates. 

A register variable C_value accumulates the result for each output element. 
This avoids repeated writes to shared memory during computation. 
The accumulator is initialized to 0.0 before the main computation loop.
textTranslate:
分块矩阵乘法内核遵循特定的工作流程。 
首先，每个线程确定其在输出矩阵 C 中的全局坐标 (m, k)。 
映射使用块和线程索引：m = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y，k = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x。 

每个线程块是线程的二维网格，通常是 16×16 或 32×32 个线程。 
该块计算 C 的 TILE_SIZE × TILE_SIZE 子矩阵。 
块内的线程使用 threadIdx.y 和 threadIdx.x 作为局部坐标。 

寄存器变量 C_value 累加每个输出元素的结果。 
这避免了在计算期间重复写入共享内存。 
累加器在主计算循环之前初始化为 0.0。

title: Tiled GEMM: Memory Access Patterns
text:
Memory access patterns are crucial for GEMM performance. 
The outer loop iterates over tiles along the K dimension: for i = 0 to TILE_NUM-1. 
TILE_NUM = (N + TILE_SIZE - 1) / TILE_SIZE calculates the number of tiles needed. 

In each iteration, threads cooperatively load tiles of A and B into shared memory. 
Matrix A is loaded in row-major order: S_A[tid_y][tid_x] = A[m * N + n_col]. 
This enables coalesced access because consecutive threads access consecutive memory locations. 

Matrix B is loaded with transposed storage: S_B[tid_x][tid_y] = B[r_row * K + k_col]. 
This transposition avoids strided access during computation. 
Without transposition, accessing B's columns would cause non-coalesced memory access. 
The transposed storage allows consecutive memory access when computing dot products.
textTranslate:
内存访问模式对 GEMM 性能至关重要。 
外部循环沿 K 维度迭代块：for i = 0 to TILE_NUM-1。 
TILE_NUM = (N + TILE_SIZE - 1) / TILE_SIZE 计算所需的块数。 

在每次迭代中，线程协作将 A 和 B 的块加载到共享内存中。 
矩阵 A 以行主序加载：S_A[tid_y][tid_x] = A[m * N + n_col]。 
这实现了合并访问，因为连续线程访问连续的内存位置。 

矩阵 B 以转置存储方式加载：S_B[tid_x][tid_y] = B[r_row * K + k_col]。 
这种转置避免了计算期间的跨步访问。 
没有转置，访问 B 的列会导致非合并的内存访问。 
转置存储允许在计算点积时进行连续的内存访问。

title: Tiled GEMM: Computation Phase
text:
After loading data into shared memory, threads synchronize using __syncthreads(). 
This barrier ensures all threads have finished loading before computation begins. 
Synchronization is critical to prevent race conditions. 

The computation phase computes dot products using shared memory data. 
Each thread computes: C_value += S_A[tid_y][j] * S_B[tid_x][j] for j = 0 to TILE_SIZE-1. 
Since S_B stores the transposed B, both S_A rows and S_B rows are accessed sequentially. 

This reduces global memory accesses from O(T³) to O(T²) for a T×T tile. 
Each element in the tile is computed T times, but data is loaded only once. 
The data reuse factor is T, significantly improving performance. 

After computation, threads synchronize again before loading the next tile. 
Finally, each thread writes C_value to global memory: C[m * K + k] = C_value.
textTranslate:
将数据加载到共享内存后，线程使用 __syncthreads() 同步。 
此屏障确保所有线程在计算开始前已完成加载。 
同步对于防止竞争条件至关重要。 

计算阶段使用共享内存数据计算点积。 
每个线程计算：C_value += S_A[tid_y][j] * S_B[tid_x][j]，j = 0 到 TILE_SIZE-1。 
由于 S_B 存储转置的 B，S_A 行和 S_B 行都是顺序访问的。 

这将对 T×T 块的全局内存访问从 O(T³) 减少到 O(T²)。 
块中的每个元素被计算 T 次，但数据只加载一次。 
数据重用因子是 T，显著提高了性能。 

计算后，线程在加载下一个块之前再次同步。 
最后，每个线程将 C_value 写入全局内存：C[m * K + k] = C_value。

title: Softmax Function: Mathematical Definition
text:
Softmax is a crucial activation function in deep learning, especially for classification tasks. 
For an input array x of length N, the Softmax function computes: σ(x)_i = e^(x_i) / Σ(e^(x_j)) for j = 1 to N. 
It normalizes input values into a probability distribution where all outputs sum to 1. 

Each output value is between 0 and 1, representing a probability. 
The function is differentiable, making it suitable for gradient-based optimization. 
It amplifies differences between large and small values through exponentiation. 

The naive implementation suffers from numerical instability due to exponential overflow. 
When x_i values are large, e^(x_i) can exceed floating-point representation limits. 
This causes NaN (Not a Number) or Inf (Infinity) results, breaking the computation.
textTranslate:
Softmax 是深度学习中至关重要的激活函数，特别是对于分类任务。 
对于长度为 N 的输入数组 x，Softmax 函数计算：σ(x)_i = e^(x_i) / Σ(e^(x_j))，j = 1 到 N。 
它将输入值归一化为概率分布，其中所有输出之和为 1。 

每个输出值在 0 和 1 之间，表示概率。 
该函数是可微分的，使其适用于基于梯度的优化。 
它通过指数运算放大大小值之间的差异。 

由于指数溢出，朴素实现存在数值不稳定性。 
当 x_i 值很大时，e^(x_i) 可能超过浮点表示限制。 
这会导致 NaN（非数字）或 Inf（无穷大）结果，破坏计算。

title: Softmax: The Max Trick
text:
The max trick ensures numerical stability while preserving mathematical correctness. 
It subtracts the maximum value from all inputs before exponentiation: σ(x)_i = e^(x_i - max) / Σ(e^(x_j - max)). 
This transformation doesn't change the result mathematically. 

Proof: e^(x_i - max) / Σ(e^(x_j - max)) = e^(x_i) * e^(-max) / (Σ(e^(x_j)) * e^(-max)) = e^(x_i) / Σ(e^(x_j)). 
The e^(-max) factors cancel out, preserving the original formula. 

By subtracting the maximum, all exponentiated values are between 0 and 1. 
The largest value becomes e^(max - max) = e^0 = 1. 
All other values are smaller, preventing overflow. 

This trick is essential for stable Softmax computation. 
It requires finding the maximum value first, then using it for normalization. 
The implementation must handle this two-step process efficiently.
textTranslate:
最大值技巧确保数值稳定性，同时保持数学正确性。 
它在指数运算之前从所有输入中减去最大值：σ(x)_i = e^(x_i - max) / Σ(e^(x_j - max))。 
这种变换在数学上不会改变结果。 

证明：e^(x_i - max) / Σ(e^(x_j - max)) = e^(x_i) * e^(-max) / (Σ(e^(x_j)) * e^(-max)) = e^(x_i) / Σ(e^(x_j))。 
e^(-max) 因子相互抵消，保留了原始公式。 

通过减去最大值，所有指数值都在 0 和 1 之间。 
最大值变为 e^(max - max) = e^0 = 1。 
所有其他值都更小，防止溢出。 

这个技巧对于稳定的 Softmax 计算至关重要。 
它需要先找到最大值，然后将其用于归一化。 
实现必须高效地处理这个两步过程。

title: Naive Softmax: Three-Kernel Implementation
text:
The naive Softmax implementation uses three separate kernel launches. 
First, a max reduction kernel finds the maximum value across all elements. 
This kernel uses shared memory reduction with each block computing a partial maximum. 

Each thread loads one element into shared memory: s_max[tid] = arr[global_tid]. 
Then threads cooperate in a binary tree reduction pattern. 
The reduction proceeds in log₂(blockDim.x) steps, halving active threads each step. 
After block-level reduction, partial maximums are copied to host memory. 
The host CPU computes the global maximum from block results. 

The second kernel computes the sum of exponentials using the max trick. 
Each thread computes exp(x_i - max) and stores it in shared memory. 
Then a reduction sums these values within each block. 
Block sums are copied to host and summed to get the total denominator. 

Finally, a normalization kernel divides each exponential value by the total sum. 
This three-kernel approach is straightforward but has overhead from multiple kernel launches and host-device transfers.
textTranslate:
朴素 Softmax 实现使用三个独立的内核启动。 
首先，最大值归约内核找到所有元素中的最大值。 
该内核使用共享内存归约，每个块计算部分最大值。 

每个线程将一个元素加载到共享内存中：s_max[tid] = arr[global_tid]。 
然后线程以二叉树归约模式协作。 
归约在 log₂(blockDim.x) 步中进行，每步将活动线程减半。 
块级归约后，部分最大值被复制到主机内存。 
主机 CPU 从块结果计算全局最大值。 

第二个内核使用最大值技巧计算指数和。 
每个线程计算 exp(x_i - max) 并将其存储在共享内存中。 
然后归约在每个块内对这些值求和。 
块和值被复制到主机并求和以获得总分母。 

最后，归一化内核将每个指数值除以总和。 
这种三内核方法简单直接，但存在多次内核启动和主机-设备传输的开销。

title: Optimized Softmax: Warp-Level Primitives
text:
The optimized per-token Softmax uses online safe softmax computation. 
It combines max finding and sum computation in a single pass using warp-level primitives. 
The key data structure is MD, containing both maximum (m) and denominator (d) values. 

Warp reduction uses __shfl_xor_sync for efficient data exchange. 
This shuffle operation allows threads within a warp to exchange values without shared memory. 
It's faster than shared memory because it uses register-to-register transfers. 

The warp_reduce_md_op function merges intervals while maintaining numerical stability. 
When merging two intervals with different maximums, the smaller interval's sum is scaled. 
The scaling factor is exp(max_smaller - max_bigger) to preserve correctness. 

This approach uses two-level reduction: first within warps, then across warps in a block. 
Each warp reduces 32 elements to one MD value. 
Then the first warp reduces warp results to get the final block result.
textTranslate:
优化的 per-token Softmax 使用在线安全 softmax 计算。 
它使用 warp 级原语在单次遍历中结合最大值查找和求和计算。 
关键数据结构是 MD，包含最大值 (m) 和分母 (d) 值。 

Warp 归约使用 __shfl_xor_sync 进行高效的数据交换。 
此 shuffle 操作允许 warp 内的线程在没有共享内存的情况下交换值。 
它比共享内存更快，因为它使用寄存器到寄存器的传输。 

warp_reduce_md_op 函数合并区间，同时保持数值稳定性。 
当合并两个具有不同最大值的区间时，较小区间的和会被缩放。 
缩放因子是 exp(max_smaller - max_bigger) 以保持正确性。 

这种方法使用两级归约：首先在 warp 内，然后在块内的 warp 之间。 
每个 warp 将 32 个元素归约为一个 MD 值。 
然后第一个 warp 归约 warp 结果以获得最终的块结果。

title: Optimized Softmax: Interval Merging
text:
The interval merging algorithm maintains numerical stability during reduction. 
When two intervals have different maximums, we must scale the smaller interval's sum. 
Consider interval 1 with max1 and sum1, interval 2 with max2 and sum2. 

If max1 > max2, interval 1's values were computed as exp(x - max1). 
To merge with interval 2 (using max1), we need exp(x - max1) = exp(x - max2) * exp(max2 - max1). 
Therefore, sum2 must be scaled by exp(max2 - max1). 

The merged result has max = max1 and sum = sum1 + sum2 * exp(max2 - max1). 
This scaling preserves mathematical correctness while preventing overflow. 
The code implements this as: value.d = bigger_m.d + smaller_m.d * __expf(smaller_m.m - bigger_m.m). 

After block-level reduction, all threads read the final MD from shared memory. 
Each thread computes its output: y[i] = exp(x[i] - max) / sum. 
This single-kernel approach eliminates multiple kernel launches and host-device transfers.
textTranslate:
区间合并算法在归约期间保持数值稳定性。 
当两个区间具有不同的最大值时，我们必须缩放较小区间的和。 
考虑区间 1 具有 max1 和 sum1，区间 2 具有 max2 和 sum2。 

如果 max1 > max2，区间 1 的值计算为 exp(x - max1)。 
要与区间 2 合并（使用 max1），我们需要 exp(x - max1) = exp(x - max2) * exp(max2 - max1)。 
因此，sum2 必须按 exp(max2 - max1) 缩放。 

合并结果具有 max = max1 和 sum = sum1 + sum2 * exp(max2 - max1)。 
这种缩放保持数学正确性，同时防止溢出。 
代码将其实现为：value.d = bigger_m.d + smaller_m.d * __expf(smaller_m.m - bigger_m.m)。 

块级归约后，所有线程从共享内存读取最终的 MD。 
每个线程计算其输出：y[i] = exp(x[i] - max) / sum。 
这种单内核方法消除了多次内核启动和主机-设备传输。

title: Reduction Operations: Tree-Based Approach
titleTranslate: 归约操作：基于树的方法
text:
Reduction is a fundamental parallel pattern that combines multiple values into one. 
Common reduction operations include sum, max, min, and product. 
The challenge is to efficiently parallelize this inherently sequential operation. 

CUDA reduction uses a tree-based approach with shared memory. 
Each thread loads one element into shared memory: shared_input[local_idx] = input[global_idx]. 
Then threads cooperate to reduce values in a binary tree pattern. 

The reduction proceeds in log₂(N) steps, halving the active threads each step. 
In step i, threads with local_idx < offset add shared_input[local_idx + offset] to shared_input[local_idx]. 
The offset starts at blockDim.x / 2 and halves each iteration. 
After log₂(blockDim.x) steps, thread 0 holds the block's reduction result. 

After block-level reduction, results from multiple blocks are combined. 
This can be done on the host CPU or with a second kernel launch. 
This two-stage approach enables efficient parallel reduction on large arrays.
textTranslate:
归约是将多个值组合成一个的基本并行模式。 
常见的归约操作包括求和、最大值、最小值和乘积。 
挑战在于高效地并行化这种固有的顺序操作。 

CUDA 归约使用基于树的方法和共享内存。 
每个线程将一个元素加载到共享内存中：shared_input[local_idx] = input[global_idx]。 
然后线程协作以二叉树模式归约值。 

归约在 log₂(N) 步中进行，每步将活动线程减半。 
在第 i 步中，local_idx < offset 的线程将 shared_input[local_idx + offset] 加到 shared_input[local_idx]。 
offset 从 blockDim.x / 2 开始，每次迭代减半。 
经过 log₂(blockDim.x) 步后，线程 0 保存块的归约结果。 

块级归约后，合并来自多个块的结果。 
这可以在主机 CPU 上完成，也可以通过第二次内核启动完成。 
这种两阶段方法使得能够在大数组上高效并行归约。

title: Reduction: Synchronization and Bank Conflicts
text:
Synchronization is critical in reduction kernels. 
__syncthreads() ensures all threads finish loading before reduction begins. 
It also ensures all threads finish each reduction step before the next step starts. 
Without synchronization, threads may read incorrect values from shared memory. 

Shared memory is organized into banks for parallel access. 
On most GPUs, shared memory has 32 banks (one per warp lane). 
Consecutive 32-bit words map to consecutive banks. 

Bank conflicts occur when multiple threads access the same bank simultaneously. 
This serializes access, reducing performance. 
In reduction, bank conflicts can occur when threads access shared_input[tid] and shared_input[tid + offset]. 

To avoid bank conflicts, some implementations use padding. 
Adding padding to shared memory arrays shifts bank mappings. 
This ensures threads access different banks, enabling parallel access. 
However, padding wastes memory, so it's a trade-off between performance and memory usage.
textTranslate:
同步在归约内核中至关重要。 
__syncthreads() 确保所有线程在归约开始前完成加载。 
它还确保所有线程在下一步开始前完成每个归约步骤。 
没有同步，线程可能从共享内存读取错误的值。 

共享内存被组织成 bank 以实现并行访问。 
在大多数 GPU 上，共享内存有 32 个 bank（每个 warp lane 一个）。 
连续的 32 位字映射到连续的 bank。 

当多个线程同时访问同一个 bank 时，会发生 bank 冲突。 
这会串行化访问，降低性能。 
在归约中，当线程访问 shared_input[tid] 和 shared_input[tid + offset] 时可能发生 bank 冲突。 

为避免 bank 冲突，某些实现使用填充。 
向共享内存数组添加填充会移动 bank 映射。 
这确保线程访问不同的 bank，实现并行访问。 
但是，填充浪费内存，所以这是性能和内存使用之间的权衡。

title: ReLU: Simple Element-Wise Operation
text:
ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit) is a simple but effective activation function. 
It sets all negative values to zero and leaves positive values unchanged. 
Mathematically: ReLU(x) = max(0, x). 

ReLU is computationally efficient and helps with gradient flow in deep networks. 
Unlike sigmoid or tanh, ReLU doesn't saturate for positive inputs. 
This prevents the vanishing gradient problem in deep networks. 

The CUDA implementation is straightforward: each thread processes one element. 
The kernel simply applies max(0, input[i]) for each element. 
No synchronization or shared memory is needed, making ReLU very fast. 

This element-wise operation maps perfectly to GPU parallelism. 
Each thread independently computes its output value. 
The operation is memory-bound, so performance depends on memory bandwidth. 
Coalesced memory access ensures maximum bandwidth utilization.
textTranslate:
ReLU（修正线性单元）是一个简单但有效的激活函数。 
它将所有负值设置为零，并保持正值不变。 
数学上：ReLU(x) = max(0, x)。 

ReLU 计算效率高，有助于深度网络中的梯度流动。 
与 sigmoid 或 tanh 不同，ReLU 对正输入不会饱和。 
这防止了深度网络中的梯度消失问题。 

CUDA 实现很简单：每个线程处理一个元素。 
内核简单地对每个元素应用 max(0, input[i])。 
不需要同步或共享内存，使 ReLU 非常快。 

这种逐元素操作完美映射到 GPU 并行性。 
每个线程独立计算其输出值。 
该操作是内存受限的，因此性能取决于内存带宽。 
合并的内存访问确保最大带宽利用率。

title: 1D Convolution: Mathematical Definition
text:
Convolution is a fundamental operation in signal processing and deep learning. 
1D convolution applies a kernel (filter) to an input array. 
The output size is input_size - kernel_size + 1 with valid padding. 

Mathematically, convolution computes: output[i] = Σ(input[i+j] * kernel[j]) for j = 0 to kernel_size-1. 
Each output element is a weighted sum of input elements. 
The kernel slides across the input, computing dot products at each position. 

This creates a natural parallelization opportunity. 
Each output element can be computed independently. 
In CUDA, each thread computes one output element. 

The thread loads the corresponding input segment and kernel. 
Then it computes the dot product between them. 
Memory access patterns should be optimized for coalescing to achieve good performance.
textTranslate:
卷积是信号处理和深度学习中的基本操作。 
一维卷积将内核（滤波器）应用于输入数组。 
使用有效填充时，输出大小为 input_size - kernel_size + 1。 

数学上，卷积计算：output[i] = Σ(input[i+j] * kernel[j])，j = 0 到 kernel_size-1。 
每个输出元素是输入元素的加权和。 
内核在输入上滑动，在每个位置计算点积。 

这创造了自然的并行化机会。 
每个输出元素可以独立计算。 
在 CUDA 中，每个线程计算一个输出元素。 

线程加载相应的输入段和内核。 
然后它计算它们之间的点积。 
内存访问模式应针对合并进行优化以实现良好的性能。

title: Memory Hierarchy and Coalescing
titleTranslate: 内存层次结构和合并访问
text:
GPU memory hierarchy consists of registers, shared memory, and global memory. 
Registers are the fastest but limited per thread (typically 255 per thread). 
Shared memory is fast (similar to L1 cache) but limited per block (typically 48KB). 
Global memory is slowest but largest (several GB). 

Coalesced memory access maximizes memory bandwidth utilization. 
When threads in a warp access consecutive memory locations, the hardware combines them into a single transaction. 
This achieves near-peak memory bandwidth. 

Non-coalesced access occurs when threads access scattered memory locations. 
This requires multiple memory transactions, wasting bandwidth. 
For example, accessing matrix columns in row-major storage causes strided access. 

To achieve coalescing, threads should access memory in a contiguous pattern. 
For 32-bit data, 32 threads should access 32 consecutive words. 
The starting address should be aligned to 128 bytes for optimal performance.
textTranslate:
GPU 内存层次结构包括寄存器、共享内存和全局内存。 
寄存器最快，但每个线程有限（通常每个线程 255 个）。 
共享内存很快（类似于 L1 缓存），但每个块有限（通常 48KB）。 
全局内存最慢但最大（几 GB）。 

合并的内存访问最大化内存带宽利用率。 
当 warp 中的线程访问连续的内存位置时，硬件将它们组合成单个事务。 
这实现了接近峰值的内存带宽。 

当线程访问分散的内存位置时，会发生非合并访问。 
这需要多次内存事务，浪费带宽。 
例如，在行主序存储中访问矩阵列会导致跨步访问。 

为了实现合并，线程应该以连续模式访问内存。 
对于 32 位数据，32 个线程应该访问 32 个连续的字。 
起始地址应对齐到 128 字节以获得最佳性能。

title: Performance Optimization: Occupancy
text:
Occupancy measures how many warps are active per streaming multiprocessor (SM). 
Higher occupancy can hide memory latency by switching between warps. 
However, higher occupancy also means less resources per thread. 

Occupancy depends on three factors: threads per block, shared memory per block, and registers per thread. 
Each SM has limited resources: typically 2048 threads, 48KB shared memory, 65536 registers. 
The limiting factor determines maximum occupancy. 

For example, if each thread uses 64 registers and each block has 256 threads, we need 256 * 64 = 16384 registers per block. 
With 65536 registers per SM, we can have 4 blocks per SM. 
With 2048 threads per SM, 4 blocks * 256 threads = 1024 threads, giving 50% occupancy. 

Optimal occupancy is usually around 50-75%. 
Too low occupancy wastes SM resources. 
Too high occupancy may reduce performance due to register spilling. 
Profiling tools help find the optimal balance.
textTranslate:
占用率衡量每个流式多处理器 (SM) 有多少 warp 处于活动状态。 
更高的占用率可以通过在 warp 之间切换来隐藏内存延迟。 
但是，更高的占用率也意味着每个线程的资源更少。 

占用率取决于三个因素：每个块的线程数、每个块的共享内存和每个线程的寄存器数。 
每个 SM 的资源有限：通常 2048 个线程、48KB 共享内存、65536 个寄存器。 
限制因素决定最大占用率。 

例如，如果每个线程使用 64 个寄存器，每个块有 256 个线程，我们每个块需要 256 * 64 = 16384 个寄存器。 
每个 SM 有 65536 个寄存器，我们每个 SM 可以有 4 个块。 
每个 SM 有 2048 个线程，4 个块 * 256 个线程 = 1024 个线程，占用率为 50%。 

最佳占用率通常在 50-75% 左右。 
占用率太低会浪费 SM 资源。 
占用率太高可能会因寄存器溢出而降低性能。 
性能分析工具有助于找到最佳平衡。

title: Performance Optimization: Warp-Level Primitives
text:
Warp-level primitives enable efficient communication within a warp. 
__shfl_sync allows threads to read values from other threads' registers. 
This avoids shared memory access, reducing latency and bank conflicts. 

__shfl_xor_sync performs a butterfly reduction pattern. 
Thread i exchanges data with thread i XOR stride. 
This enables efficient reduction within a warp without shared memory. 

__ballot_sync returns a bitmask indicating which threads satisfy a condition. 
This is useful for conditional operations and reductions. 
__any_sync and __all_sync check if any or all threads satisfy a condition. 

These primitives are faster than shared memory for warp-level operations. 
They use register-to-register transfers, avoiding memory hierarchy. 
However, they only work within a single warp (32 threads). 
For block-level operations, combine warp primitives with shared memory.
textTranslate:
Warp 级原语支持 warp 内的高效通信。 
__shfl_sync 允许线程从其他线程的寄存器读取值。 
这避免了共享内存访问，减少了延迟和 bank 冲突。 

__shfl_xor_sync 执行蝴蝶归约模式。 
线程 i 与线程 i XOR stride 交换数据。 
这可以在没有共享内存的情况下在 warp 内进行高效归约。 

__ballot_sync 返回一个位掩码，指示哪些线程满足条件。 
这对于条件操作和归约很有用。 
__any_sync 和 __all_sync 检查是否有任何或所有线程满足条件。 

这些原语对于 warp 级操作比共享内存更快。 
它们使用寄存器到寄存器的传输，避免内存层次结构。 
但是，它们只在单个 warp（32 个线程）内工作。 
对于块级操作，将 warp 原语与共享内存结合使用。

title: Performance Profiling and Analysis
text:
Profiling tools like Nsight Compute help identify performance bottlenecks. 
They provide detailed metrics: occupancy, memory throughput, compute utilization. 
Understanding these metrics guides optimization efforts. 

The roofline model visualizes performance limits. 
It plots compute intensity (operations per byte) against performance. 
Operators below the roofline are memory-bound. 
Operators on the roofline are compute-bound. 

The goal is to maximize compute utilization while minimizing memory traffic. 
For memory-bound kernels, focus on reducing memory accesses. 
For compute-bound kernels, focus on increasing parallelism and instruction throughput. 

Common optimizations include: using shared memory, coalescing memory access, reducing register usage, and increasing occupancy. 
Each optimization may affect others, requiring careful tuning. 
Iterative profiling and optimization lead to best performance.
textTranslate:
像 Nsight Compute 这样的性能分析工具有助于识别性能瓶颈。 
它们提供详细的指标：占用率、内存吞吐量、计算利用率。 
理解这些指标指导优化工作。 

屋顶线模型可视化性能限制。 
它绘制计算强度（每字节操作数）与性能的关系。 
屋顶线以下的算子是内存受限的。 
屋顶线上的算子是计算受限的。 

目标是最大化计算利用率，同时最小化内存流量。 
对于内存受限的内核，专注于减少内存访问。 
对于计算受限的内核，专注于增加并行性和指令吞吐量。 

常见的优化包括：使用共享内存、合并内存访问、减少寄存器使用和增加占用率。 
每个优化可能影响其他优化，需要仔细调整。 
迭代的性能分析和优化带来最佳性能。
